carrick-names-united-team-roma: Manchester United host Roma at Old Trafford on Tuesday 3 November 2026 in Champions League league phase Matchday 4, kick-off 8pm UK time. Manager Michael Carrick's team selection was announced by the club on X. United are winless in nine games in all competitions and 21st in the league-phase table. Luke Shaw, Patrick Dorgu, Manuel Ugarte and Benjamin Sesko are unavailable. Marcus Rashford has been a doubt with a hip injury. Lisandro Martinez was sent off in the 2-0 defeat at Chelsea; his ban covers domestic games only so he was available for this match. Carrick said on Monday that Shaw definitely would not be around this week and of Rashford 'we'll just have to see, day by day'.
iraola-press-conference-fenerbahce-nyoni: Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola held his press conference in Istanbul before Liverpool's Champions League Matchday 4 tie against Fenerbahce. The club's post on X said the topics were the Fenerbahce challenge, Istanbul and Trey Nyoni. Liverpool lost 1-0 at home to Arsenal on 1 November 2026 and failed to record a shot on target at Anfield in a Premier League game for the first time on record. Liverpool are nine points behind leaders Arsenal. Cody Gakpo also spoke to the media before the tie.
arteta-anfield-game-plan-havertz: Arsenal won 1-0 at Liverpool on Sunday 1 November 2026, their first win at Anfield since 2012, ending a run of 16 trips without a win. Kai Havertz scored in the 16th minute, converting Declan Rice's low cross at the far post after Martin Odegaard cut out an Alisson clearance. Mikel Arteta's side then defended deep and Liverpool had 17 attempts but none on target, the first time on record Liverpool failed to record a shot on target in a Premier League home game. Jurrien Timber made crucial blocks. Sky Sports noted officials missed a tug by Timber on Alexander Isak that might have been a penalty. Arsenal went top, three points clear of Manchester City and nine clear of Liverpool, with 24 points from nine games. Havertz became the top-scoring German in Premier League history with 46 goals. Arsenal play Slavia Prague away in the Champions League on Wednesday.
carrick-under-pressure-roma: Michael Carrick is under heavy pressure as Manchester United manager. United lost 2-0 at Chelsea on Saturday, with Lisandro Martinez sent off. United are winless in nine games in all competitions, which reportedly has not happened since 1988, and are 17th in the Premier League, above the relegation zone on goal difference. They lost their last two Champions League games against Atletico Madrid and Como (4-1). Radio Times reported Carrick was given the club's backing last week but another home defeat could cost him his job. Carrick said at Monday's press conference: 'The dressing room is in a good place.' Pundits at Sports Illustrated argued Martinez's form means he has to come out of the team. Roma, under Gian Piero Gasperini, are unbeaten in Serie A with seven wins and three draws.
